Every sequence has one structural-event label and each of corridor, junction, terminal, turn and geometry-transition has at least 500 training sequences.
At least 98 percent of sequences have complete native-mesh width/height targets; missing non-junction geometry is at most 0.5 percent and is masked without deletion or radius backfill.
Exactly zero validation, C10, M-TARE, model inference, teacher export, training and optimizer access occurs.
All source assets remain unchanged and the run preserves 80-world JSONL, CSV/JSON, PNG/vector PDF, raw log, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal within 100 MiB.

The analytic-radius teacher remains the scientific baseline and produced zero geometry-transition examples.
